group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 摩擦と確率力を運動方程式に加える。平衡の温度を指定するには摩擦と雑音を揺動散逸関係で結ぶ。
summary.en: Add friction and random forces to the equations of motion. The fluctuation–dissipation relation connects friction and noise at the target equilibrium temperature.

caution.ja: 摩擦は実時間の相関・拡散に影響する。有限刻みでの標本化誤差は積分法と刻み幅も含めて調べる。
caution.en: Friction changes dynamical correlations and diffusion. Finite-step sampling errors must be assessed together with the integration scheme.

references.label: Bussi & Parrinello (2007), Accurate sampling using Langevin dynamics
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

next_deliverable.ja: 専用の定式化・積分手順を整理し、固定入力、自由度・乱数・刻み幅を明記した分布と時間相関の検証例を追加する。
next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.
